chapter one

Our Story

Some people search their whole lives for someone who feels like home. I got lucky, I have you. I just looked up one day and there you were, making everything softer, warmer, and so much brighter than it ever was before.

Every year with you rearranges the stars a little. Twenty-three looks incredible on you, it looks like sunlight, inside jokes, and a future I can't wait to see you flourish in.

chapter three

Happy Birthday Baby Kudakwashe

To Kudakwashe, on turning 23 — a small letter, waiting for you...
❦
tap the envelope to open it

My Kudakwashe,

Happy 23rd birthday, my love. I wanted to put this in writing because some feelings deserve to be kept forever, not just spoken in a moment.

Turning twenty-three is a milestone, but to me, it's just another year of watching you grow, thicker and more beautiful. I love every side of you, the laughter you share so freely, the gentle way you care for everyone around you, and the way you effortlessly make my world feel whole.

I pray this year brings you all the success you deserve, endless peace, and unforgettable joy. May it be soft when you need rest, and grand when you reach for your dreams. No matter where this year takes us, my favorite place will always be right next to you.

yours, kevin
